_comment: Copy to <data dir>/config.json (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/ekko/, Linux: ~/.local/share/ekko/, Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\ekko\). Every key is optional; delete the ones you don't use. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_comment_backends: llm_backend picks how summaries and context snapshots are produced: 'api' (HTTP with one of the keys below) or 'claude-cli' (runs `claude -p` on your Claude Code subscription; slower per call, no key needed). Unset = auto: api if a key is present, else claude-cli if `claude` is on PATH.
_comment_query: Interactive tools (ask_question, semantic/hybrid search) can use a different, faster backend than the background indexer. Both default to the llm_* settings above.
_comment_keys: API keys for the 'api' backend. OpenAI-family models (gpt*, o*) go to OpenAI, or to Azure when AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT is set (then llm_model/query_model must be an Azure deployment name). claude-* models go to Anthropic.
_comment_tuning: max_workers caps concurrent LLM calls in `ekko index` (default 7 for api, 1 for claude-cli). cli_timeout_secs bounds one CLI completion. web_port is where `ekko web` listens on 127.0.0.1.
_comment_web: web_serve: true makes every `ekko mcp` race to host the web UI on web_port (exactly one serves at a time). Off by default; `ekko web` runs it standalone.
_comment_paths: database_path relocates sessions.db; session_paths overrides transcript discovery per source.
